verdict: Organic holding steady; paid channels remain paused this period.
narrative: Paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive for the full 28-day window, so all activity this period is organic. Your Google Business Profile drove 157 actions — including 61 calls and 58 direction requests — which shows the profile is still pulling real interest without ad support. That said, Google Business Profile engagement has softened noticeably in the final days of this window, and website sessions are down week-over-week, so organic momentum is not building on its own. Of the 147 contacts logged this period, only 7 reached opportunity stage, pointing to a gap in how contacts are being followed up or tracked through intake — that is being reviewed now. With the engagement period closing October 31, the priority this week is clarifying next steps on paid reactivation and contact conversion so nothing is lost in the transition.

watch_item.issue: The large gap between contacts received (147) and opportunities tracked (7) suggests most inquiries are not making it through the intake process as recorded.
watch_item.fix: The contact and tagging workflow is being audited this week to close the gap and ensure no incoming leads are falling through untracked.
